en.bdb: Only he remains poised in a sham whom the Guru is graceful

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਲੂਣ ਜਿਉ ਘਿਅ ਚੋਪੜਿ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jal vich kaagadh loon jiau ghia chopaR paae|

en.bdb: Applying butter to the paper and salt they can be put into water (they will take longer time to dissolve).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਵੇ ਵਟੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dheeve vaTee tel dhe sabh raat jalaae|

en.bdb: With the help of oil, the wick of the lamp goes on burning the whole night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਰ ਫੜਿ ਗੁਡੀ ਓਡਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vai ma(n)ddal jiau ddor faR guddee oddaae|

en.bdb: Catching hold of the string, the kite could be made to fly in the sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਰੜ ਦੁਗਾਰੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਸਪੁ ਲੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: muh vich garaR dhugaar pai jiau sap laRaae|

en.bdb: By keeping an herb in the mouth, one could get bitten by serpent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: raajaa firai fakeer hoi sun dhukh miTaae|

en.bdb: If the king goes out in the guise of a faquire, he could listen to the sufferings of people and remove them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਗੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਹਾਏ ॥੨੩॥੩੫॥
verses.translit_en: saa(n)gai a(n)dhar saabataa jis guroo sahaae ||23||35||

en.bdb: In such a feat only he passes the test who is helped by the Guru.
